title: Bayesian Inference using the Structured Coalescent
text: basic example usage. First, sample heterochronous dated structured phylogenetic tree n=10n=10 leaves obtained d=3d=3 demes 2015 2020. simulated phylogeny returned object class strphylo can passed directly MCMC algorithm initialisation point. Alternatively, illustrate convert strphylo phylogeny BEAST-annotated Newick string using treeio package. strphylo phylogeny can converted Newick string via treedata object follows, resulting Newick string can return annotated Newick string (demes annotated type) original strphylo object follows Note require textConnection() allow Newick string (stored character vector) passed file connection read.beast.newick(). Alternatively, Newick string can passed external file using path file. Now structured phylogeny strphylo format use initialisation, identify prior parameters use MCMC. use default prior distributions, can either omit prior parameters MCMC, can pass prior parameters MCMC using mode-variance parameterisation Gamma distribution MCMC output consists three files (default added current working directory getwd()): StructCoalescent.trees contains thinned MCMC sample dated structured phylogenies BEAST meta-commented Newick format, can read treeio::read.beast. StructCoalescent.log contains thinned MCMC sample evolutionary parameters, likelihood evaluations current radius subtree csv format, can read read.csv StructCoalescent.freq contains details total number accepted proposals type well total number attempted proposals type. can present sample migration histories using consensus migration history, sections branch assigned deme provided proportion pp sampled migration histories observe deme position follows:  Evolutionary parameter samples can presented variety ways including trace plots histograms:
code: n <- 10 d <- 3 leaf_data <- cbind('Leaf_ID'=paste0('L', 1:n),                    'Leaf_age'=sample(2018:2020, n, TRUE),                    'Leaf_deme'=sample(1:d, n, TRUE)) coalescent_rates <- rexp(d, 1) migration_matrix <- matrix(rexp(d^2, 20), d, d); diag(migration_matrix) <- 0   strphylo <- rstrphylo(n, d, coalescent_rates, migration_matrix, leaf_data) plot(strphylo, time_axis=TRUE, root_time=strphylo$root.age, show.tip.label=TRUE) treedata <- treeio::as.treedata( strphylo ) newick_string <- treeio::write.beast.newick( treedata ) #> (((((((L1[&type=2]:1.307570019,L8[&type=2]:0.3075700191)[&type=2]:0.3614643143,L5[&type=2]:1.669034333)[&type=2]:1.425505973,(L6[&type=2]:1.054246555,L10[&type=2]:1.054246555)[&type=2]:0.04029375171)[&type=2]:3.50854755)[&type=1]:0.390826112,((L9[&type=1]:1.612581503,L4[&type=1]:0.6125815034)[&type=1]:0.3764541975,L2[&type=1]:1.989035701)[&type=1]:4.004878268)[&type=1]:0.6040162555)[&type=3]:0.1235585534,(L7[&type=3]:3.382411688,(L3[&type=1]:3.971524459)[&type=3]:0.410887229)[&type=3]:3.33907709)[&type=3]; treedata <- treeio::read.beast.newick(   textConnection( newick_string ) ) strphylo <- as.strphylo( treedata ) # NOT RUN StructCoalescent_mcmc(N=1e4, strphylo, coalescent_rates, migration_matrix, stdout_log=FALSE, thin=100, proposal_rates=c(20, 1, 1)) prior_parameters <- default_priors( strphylo, n_deme = 3, M = fitch( strphylo )$min_migs ) #>     cr_shape      cr_rate      cr_mode       cr_var     mm_shape      mm_rate  #>  1.000000000  2.256252677  0.000000000  0.443212770  1.000000000 31.546311630  #>      mm_mode       mm_var  #>  0.000000000  0.001004854 # NOT RUN StructCoalescent_mcmc(N=1e4, strphylo, coalescent_rates, migration_matrix,                       cr_mode = 0, cr_var = 0.443212770,                       mm_mode = 0, mm_var = 0.001004854,                       stdout_log=FALSE, thin=100, proposal_rates=c(20, 1, 1)) strphylo_list <- lapply(treeio::read.beast('./StructCoalescent.trees'), as.strphylo) consensus_strphylo <- exact_consensus(strphylo_list, consensus_prob=0.75)

title: Bayesian Inference using the Structured Coalescent
code: StructCoalescent_log <- read.csv('./StructCoalescent.log',                                  header=TRUE) layout(matrix(1:d^2, d, d)) for (col_id in 1:d){   for (row_id in 1:d){     if (col_id == row_id){       col_name <- paste0('coal_rate_', col_id)       title <- list(paste0('theta[', col_id, ']'))       true_param <- coalescent_rates[col_id]     } else{       col_name <- paste('backward_migration_rate', row_id, col_id, sep='_')       title <- paste0('lambda[', row_id, ',', col_id, ']')       true_param <- migration_matrix[row_id, col_id]     }     plot(StructCoalescent_log$sample, StructCoalescent_log[,col_name], type='l', xlab='Sample', ylab=title)     abline(h=true_param, lty=2, col='red')   } }
